decisions.reason: Known parent lane is initialized only while negative; lanes[parentIndex] then remains stable. Duplicate first-row ownership and 120 DAGs plus 1000 parser fuzz cases agree with the old implementation.
missingParentLanes[parent] is assigned only if nil, exactly retaining the first assigned lane. The explicit a missing / b missing fixture and 1145 comparisons pass.

All unique SHAs are indexed before lane assignment, so later rows are already known. Bool slots preserve the original occupancy rule. 80 production DAGs also compare lanes/parents to buildCommitGraph.
